research_question: Can an external observation-invariance contract reject an adapter that reveals the opponent die even when ordinary extensive-form structural checks pass?

mutation.only_change: Replace (own_die, public_bids) with (both_dice, public_bids) as the information-set key.

hypothesis_recorded_before_execution.reason: Refining an information set with hidden state can preserve legal-action consistency and perfect recall while modeling the wrong observations.

secondary_demonstration.interpretation: Passing inside the mutant adapter would establish only equilibrium in the incorrectly observed game. It is not a gate for semantic correctness.

limitations: This audit covers one deliberately injected private-information leak in one small game.
The trusted visibility contract is manually specified and is not inferred from the candidate adapter.
A successful negative control does not establish performance on natural LLM-generated errors or held-out games.
